notes:
I couldn't write the Nahum 2 notes this time, because none of my research worked.

My first attempt to download pages failed. My code wrongly assumed the pages would come back as structured data rather than text, so it crashed before saving or showing me anything. After that I wasn't allowed to make any more web requests in this turn. My other tools can't reach the internet, so I couldn't try again another way.

As a result, I haven't read any of the sources. You asked for notes based only on what the pages actually say, with a link for each point, so writing them now would mean guessing. I'd rather leave them out than fill the gaps from memory.

**If you ask again, I'll start with these pages:**
- Enduring Word: enduringword.com/bible-commentary/nahum-2/
- Precept Austin: preceptaustin.org/nahum-2-commentary
- Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Gill on Bible Hub: biblehub.com/commentaries/[ellicott | pulpit | gill]/nahum/2.htm
- NET Bible notes: netbible.org/bible/Nahum+2

After those I'll search for the questions where views differ. These include:
- whether "one who scatters" in v. 1 means Babylon and the Medes or something more
- how "Jacob" and "Israel" are meant in v. 2
- what the river gates in vv. 6–8 refer to
- any Catholic or Orthodox readings

The notes will be verse by verse, with a link after each point.
